# UIL4B

> UIL4B is a free, browser-based design toolkit and UI-inspiration platform for designers and developers. Build colour systems, pair fonts, browse 200k+ icons, convert images and video, generate accessible alt text and AI image/landing prompts, and export production-ready CSS and design tokens — all client-side, with a free tier and a $4.99/mo Pro plan.

## Tools
- [Colour Palette Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/color): Build palettes with harmony modes, tint scales, gradients, image extraction, named colour libraries, and CSS/Tailwind/PNG/SVG export.
- [Font Pair Finder](https://www.uil4b.com/create/font-pair): Discover and preview Google Font pairings for headings and body, with live samples and CSS import export.
- [Font Gallery](https://www.uil4b.com/create/font-gallery): Browse and compare 1,200+ Google Fonts by category, weight, and style.
- [Type Scale Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/type-scale): Create modular type scales and export CSS/Tailwind/SCSS custom properties.
- [Icon Library](https://www.uil4b.com/create/icons): Search 200,000+ open-source icons and copy SVG or JSX instantly.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/box-shadow): Design layered CSS box shadows with live preview and Tailwind output.
- [File Converter](https://www.uil4b.com/create/file-converter): Convert images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF), turn video into GIFs, and extract video frames — fully in-browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Emoji Library](https://www.uil4b.com/create/emoji): Search and copy emoji by category with skin-tone variants.
- [UI Builder](https://www.uil4b.com/create/component-designer): Assemble a complete design system (colour, type and scale) and export production-ready CSS.

## AI tools
- [AI Image Prompt Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/ai-prompt): Build structured, high-quality image prompts; scan a reference photo to extract its style.
- [AI Landing Page Prompts](https://www.uil4b.com/create/landing-prompts): Generate landing-page copy and structure prompts for AI website builders.
- [Alt Text Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/alt-text): Generate WCAG-compliant alt text for images with AI.

## Documentation
- [SEO for Small Business](https://www.uil4b.com/docs-seo): Practical SEO fundamentals — local SEO, on-page, technical, and 2026 AI-search guidance.
- [Marketing Fundamentals](https://www.uil4b.com/docs-marketing): Positioning, funnels, email, paid, and analytics for designers and small businesses.
- [Brand Colour Guide](https://www.uil4b.com/docs-brand): How to choose brand colours — psychology, contrast, accessibility, and palette building.
- [UI Design Themes](https://www.uil4b.com/docs-themes): Dark/light theming, current UI trends, and real-brand examples.
- [AI Coding Assistants](https://www.uil4b.com/docs-ai): How to use Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and other AI tools for web development.

## More
- [Pricing](https://www.uil4b.com/#pricing): Free forever for core tools; Pro from $4.99/mo AUD for higher AI limits and synced projects.
- [Help Centre](https://www.uil4b.com/help): FAQs and support.
